name: 静奢风 / Quiet Luxury
scope: 当代简洁空间、触感光影与材料呈现。
distinctive_features: 当代简洁空间、触感光影与材料呈现。
与老钱的历史传承场景区分；原有logo与华丽织物不能被风格删去。
base_policy: 未选新组件时保留旧配方；明确用途/媒介/逐张计划替换冲突段，不能把本卡与旧pack重复累加。
input_requirements: 明确当前商品参考及不可改事实；仅展示有依据的视角。
人物来源与允许调整项沿用当前人物记录；不得把服装图中的人脸自动当作身份授权。
boundaries: 风格名是已定义摄影配方，不代表该国家全部审美或人物国籍。
适用品类/anti_categories是默认推荐线索；用户明确保留商品借用摄影时，按实际结构与适龄边界适配，不改成推荐服种。
当前修订未获得新实图验收，旧样片的接受只保留原范围。
garment_preservation: 服装和允许搭配分别记录；原商品的版型、衣长、领袖、开合、层次、颜色、材质、图案、标识及配饰以参考为准。
配色与艺术语言不得给原商品染色、增删装饰、收腰、加长或改变露肤范围。
身份、年龄、体型与头眼动作由当前人物条件和逐张计划决定，风格名不决定人物国籍、族群或脸型。
照片只能证明可见特征；手工、手织、手绣、材质成分等来源声明须另有依据。
planning_requirements: 场景列表给空间候选，不能由其顺序改变逐张动作。
单张/系列/独立比较/融合按本次意图，多个名称不自动混在一张图。

photography.scene: 安静的高级日常地点：当代公寓客厅、画廊、酒店大堂或设计师工作室，有少量考究家具与材质，空间简洁但不空。
photography.lighting: 自然柔光保留实际面料表面与体积；商品没有羊绒、丝或精纺羊毛时，以光线呈现现有材质，不替换面料。
photography.composition: 材料优先的取景与疏密安排；商品缺少典型静奢特征时，以光线与构图表达 material-first 的细腻感。 每张按已确认的逐张计划组织。
photography.palette: 环境采用灰米、灰褐、奶油与炭灰的中性大地色。 商品原色与饱和度保持不变。

prompt_fragment: 本卡审美意图：静奢编辑摄影：当代、内敛、以材料的可见质感为中心，不靠品牌标识或臆造昂贵材质表达。 摄影内容只使用本次解析后的 photography 字段；人物气质仅按当前人物条件处理，不另行拼接旧 pack 全文。

art.direction: 静奢编辑摄影：当代、内敛、以材料的可见质感为中心，不靠品牌标识或臆造昂贵材质表达。
limits: 服装和允许搭配分别记录；原商品的版型、衣长、领袖、开合、层次、颜色、材质、图案、标识及配饰以参考为准。
配色与艺术语言不得给原商品染色、增删装饰、收腰、加长或改变露肤范围。
身份、年龄、体型与头眼动作由当前人物条件和逐张计划决定，风格名不决定人物国籍、族群或脸型。
照片只能证明可见特征；手工、手织、手绣、材质成分等来源声明须另有依据。

negatives: 不新增商品参考中没有的服装部件、图案、首饰或品牌标识
不通过拉长身体、缩腰或改变人物年龄制造风格
不加入广告标题、价格、促销语、品牌口号或海报版式；商品原有文字标识保留
no added or invented visible logos
acceptance: 商品与人物事实分别对照原始参考，不能只拿上一次生成图互相核对。
独立成图满足本次画幅与逐张计划；联系表或预览不能替代独立图片。
风格差异来自所选视觉手段，不能以改变商品或身份换取差异。
与老钱的历史传承场景区分；原有logo与华丽织物不能被风格删去。
光线、色彩与场景的具体特征可在画面中判断；不以名字或形容词代替验收。

evidence.scope: 当前修订尚无实图验收；既有历史记录保留，不自动扩展其接受范围。

scene_options: 当代公寓客厅（羊毛地毯、石材茶几）
落地窗城市天际线室内
设计师工作室面料架旁
persona: composed quiet confidence, understated modern poise, effortless refinement, no flashiness
persona_guidance: 仅当本次人物条件允许调整时采用；已锁定的身份、年龄、妆发与表情优先。composed quiet confidence, understated modern poise, effortless refinement, no flashiness

commitments.show: soft diffused daylight raking from the side so the real fabric surface and volume read clearly; neutral white balance, mid-low contrast
commitments.check: fabric texture visible in the light; soft shadows; neutral colour with no warm or golden cast, no flash glare, no glossy retouch look

commitments.show: a specific contemporary place with a few considered objects in greige, taupe, cream and charcoal: a living room with a wool rug and a stone coffee table, a contemporary gallery with one sculpture, a hotel lobby lounge with low sofas, a high apartment with a city skyline window, or a designer studio beside a fabric rack
commitments.check: each cell reads as a recognisable contemporary place with real furniture or materials; no antiques, gilt, classical columns or period decor; a six or nine grid shows at least three different places; a white or pale garment still separates from the background by tone

commitments.show: an unhurried eye-level frame; the figure slightly off-centre with one piece of furniture or architecture as a quiet counterweight; space is generous but never empty
commitments.check: level horizon; one real element balances the figure; no dramatic angles

commitments.show: composed, quiet expression with relaxed closed lips and a faint warmth; self-assured, not displaying
commitments.check: calm relaxed mouth; no broad smile, no pout, no cold stare

commitments.show: skin-first groomed makeup: even satin skin, groomed brows, a soft neutral lip; hair as the identity reference, smooth and sleek
realize: no jewellery, hair accessories or logos added
commitments.check: skin even with a soft satin finish; no glitter or bold colour; hair smooth

action_tendency: Unhurried and understated in a contemporary interior: slow steps, still weight, a light touch on furniture or fabric; never posing for display, never flaunting the garment.

pose_vocabulary.body: standing in a contemporary living room a step beside a stone coffee table, wool rug underfoot, weight on one leg, shoulders relaxed
pose_vocabulary.hands: both arms relaxed at the sides, fingers soft, hands out of pockets
pose_vocabulary.check: coffee table beside the figure, not in front of the garment; still, easy stance

pose_vocabulary.body: sitting upright on the front edge of a low sofa in a hotel lobby lounge, knees together angled to one side, body three-quarter to camera
pose_vocabulary.hands: one hand resting on the sofa cushion beside the hip, the other on the thigh near the knee
pose_vocabulary.avoid_when: garments whose key detail sits on the lap
pose_vocabulary.check: upright on the sofa edge; garment front readable; hands clear of the garment front

pose_vocabulary.body: standing in a contemporary gallery a few steps from a single sculpture, body three-quarter toward the work, face turned back toward camera
pose_vocabulary.hands: hands loosely clasped behind the back
pose_vocabulary.check: sculpture stays beside or behind the figure; garment front faces the lens

pose_vocabulary.body: standing beside a floor-to-ceiling window over a city skyline in a high apartment, body angled three-quarter, a low lounge chair next to the figure
pose_vocabulary.hands: one hand resting lightly on the back of the lounge chair, the other relaxed at the side
pose_vocabulary.check: garment lit from the window side, not silhouetted; no glass reflection crosses the garment

pose_vocabulary.body: standing beside a fabric rack in a designer studio, body three-quarter toward the rack, face turned toward camera
pose_vocabulary.hands: one hand lightly touching a fabric bolt on the rack at waist height, the other relaxed
pose_vocabulary.check: hand on the rack fabric, not on the garment; rack fabrics stay muted and do not resemble the garment

pose_vocabulary.body: slow unhurried walk toward camera across a stone-floored hotel lobby, short natural stride
pose_vocabulary.hands: arms swinging slightly at the sides
pose_vocabulary.check: small stride; garment front clear; lobby depth behind

pose_vocabulary.body: walking away from camera through a contemporary gallery toward a pale stone wall, slow stride
pose_vocabulary.hands: arms relaxed at the sides, hands out of pockets
pose_vocabulary.check: back of the garment fully readable; open floor around the figure

pose_vocabulary.body: half-body, shoulders relaxed, chin slightly lowered, soft side light across the fabric
pose_vocabulary.hands: arms relaxed at the sides, below the frame; no hand touches the garment
pose_vocabulary.check: no hand on the garment; surface texture readable up close
